purpose: Canonical machine-readable Capital State across the Registry with complete totals where proven, explicit Defitea parent/child consolidation for display TVL, and unique network contribution so nested registered companies are never counted twice.

semantics.measuredCapitalFloorUsd: Sum of non-overlapping network contributions proven by canonical sources. Defitea consolidated display TVL is not added on top of its already-registered nested companies.
semantics.networkTvlUsd: Populated only when every registered company has a complete non-overlapping total-capital binding. Defitea contributes standalone Registry #004 capital because its two nested companies also contribute independently as Registry #001/#002. Company #010 Fluid is out of scope by owner policy, not an unresolved capital gap.
semantics.defiteaFundCompanyIdentity: Defitea Fund and defitea.eth are one economic object and must publish the same consolidated current TVL: standalone Defitea plus canonical nested companies #001/#002.
semantics.defiteaIncomeBoundary: Nested-company capital consolidation does not grant factual-income aggregation authority. Child-company earned income remains separate unless explicitly authorized by the accounting canon.
semantics.capitalLayer: Primary economic role. Productivity remains orthogonal and is not added again as a second capital copy.
semantics.productiveMeasuredExposureUsd: Measured productive exposure; never added to Network capital as a separate copy. Defitea Productive exposure remains standalone-parent scope even though its displayed TVL is consolidated with nested-company capital.
semantics.doubleCountPolicy: wrapper/LP/underlying/productivity representations and parent/nested-company views contribute through one canonical economic path only
